procedure_text:
[0054] 本发明的式(I)化合物可以通过如下路线制备：
[0055] 在具体实施方式中，上述路线以式(VI)化合物和溴素为原料，如下进行，但不限于此。
[0056] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应如下执行但不限于此：往式(VI)化合物中滴加溴素，反应完成后，用碱液淬灭，依次用碱液和水洗涤，分液，得到式(I)化合物。所述碱液的具体例子包括但不限于NaOH水溶液等。
[0057] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应在大约10-30℃的温度下进行。
[0058] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中使用二氯甲烷、1,2-二氯乙烷作为溶剂。
procedure_summary: Bromine is added dropwise to the compound of formula (VI) in a chlorinated solvent; when the reaction is complete the mixture is quenched with alkali solution, washed with alkali solution and then water, and the layers are separated to give the compound of formula (I).
notes: Step (i) of the invention's route, ring bromination of the aryl methyl sulfide. The substrate is prepared in Step 2 of this section, which is why step_role is intermediate_step even though Step 1 comes first in document order. The two drawings at lines 237 and 241 show the same single arrow, the second carrying Br2, and they agree with the prose. Solvent, catalyst, initiator, brominating-agent and acid-binding-agent entries in compounds[] are the alternatives the text offers for this step, not a set of materials charged together. The text words them as lists with an optional preference; no charge, mass, volume or mole figure is printed anywhere in this section, so every quantity object is null. No initiator is named and no radical conditions are stated, so mechanism_type is ionic.

procedure_summary: The starting compound of formula (VI) is said to be obtainable from the chloromethylaniline by a known method cited to a prior patent; the drawn arrow carries sodium nitrite, sodium thiomethoxide and hydrochloric acid.
notes: Prior art, not the invention's own step: line 252 attributes the preparation of the compound of formula (VI) to known methods described in patent document CN106631941A, which is not in this document, so cross_reference_unresolved is set and the conditions are absent rather than omitted. The three reagents are read off the arrow at line 254 and appear in no written procedure, hence reagent_drawn_not_written. The reagent set is consistent with diazotisation followed by displacement of the diazonium by thiomethoxide, but the drawing is one arrow, the document states no sequence and no workup between them, so is_one_pot is left false rather than asserted, and named_reaction is left null rather than stretched to Sandmeyer. reaction_class is the overall amine-to-aryl-methyl-sulfide substitution, confidence medium because no procedure is given.

The molar ratio of the compound of formula (I) to hydrogen peroxide is stated as a range, about 1-5 and preferably 2-3, and is kept verbatim in molar_ratio_text rather than turned into an equivalents figure. [0067] 本发明的式(III)化合物可以通过如下路线制备：
[0068] 在具体实施方式中，上述路线以式(II)化合物和溴代试剂为原料，如下进行，但不限于此。

[0070] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中使用溴素、N-溴代丁二酰亚胺、或者溴化氢与双氧水的组合作为溴代试剂，优选使用溴素作为溴代试剂。

[0072] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中使用二氯甲烷、二氯乙烷、四氯化碳作为溶剂。
[0073] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中升温至40-100℃，优选升温至50-80℃。
procedure_summary: The compound of formula (II), a solvent and an optional radical initiator are mixed and heated, the brominating reagent is added dropwise, and after the reaction is complete the mixture is quenched with alkali solution, washed with alkali solution and water, the solvent is evaporated and the solid dried to give the benzylic bromide of formula (III).
notes: Step (iii), side-chain bromination of the ring methyl group. mechanism_type is radical because benzoyl peroxide and azobisisobutyronitrile are named as initiators at line 289, although line 285 words the initiator as optional (任选使用的引发剂). The brominating reagent is a choice of three at line 287, bromine, N-bromosuccinimide, or hydrogen bromide with hydrogen peroxide, with bromine preferred; hydrogen peroxide is listed here only as the second half of that combination. named_reaction is left null: the transformation is a Wohl-Ziegler bromination only when N-bromosuccinimide is the reagent chosen, and the preferred reagent is elemental bromine, so naming it would over-read the text. Temperature is the stated 40-100 degrees C printed at line 293, which also gives a preferred sub-range of 50-80 degrees C. The preferred sub-range is carried as the tag temperature_preferred_c:50-80, because conditions.temperature holds one range and the schema forbids extra keys, so a tag is the only field on the record that can hold a second range where a consumer can find it. The 16 tag categories the pass lists have no category for it; this one is added rather than dropping a printed number. Solvent, catalyst, initiator, brominating-agent and acid-binding-agent entries in compounds[] are the alternatives the text offers for this step, not a set of materials charged together. The text words them as lists with an optional preference; no charge, mass, volume or mole figure is printed anywhere in this section, so every quantity object is null. The solvent list at line 291 reads 二氯甲烷、二氯乙烷、四氯化碳, and the second of the three is printed without a locant. It is rendered here as dichloroethane, not 1,2-dichloroethane: line 250 does print 1,2-二氯乙烷 for the Step 1 bromination, but that is a different sentence about a different step and reading its locant back into this one would add a fact line 291 does not state. A1 records the same compound with the Chinese identifier 二氯乙烷 and the English alias dichloroethane, so the join here is on that alias and no compound is missing from A1.

[0074] 本发明的式(IV)化合物可以通过如下路线制备：
[0075] 在具体实施方式中，上述路线以式(III)化合物和三氟乙醇钠或三氟乙醇钾为原料，如下进行，但不限于此。
[0076] 上式中，CF3CH2OM为CF3CH2ONa或CF3CH2OK。
[0077] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应可以如下执行但不限于此：将式(III)化合物和三氟乙醇钠或三氟乙醇钾分别溶于溶剂中，将式(III)化合物的溶液滴加到三氟乙醇钠或三氟乙醇钾溶液中。反应完毕后，加水淬灭，分液，用饱和食盐水洗涤有机层，蒸除溶剂，用甲醇或乙醇重结晶，干燥，得到式(IV)化合物。
[0078] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中使用四氢呋喃、1,4-二氧六环、乙醚作为溶剂，优选使用无水四氢呋喃作为溶剂。

procedure_summary: The compound of formula (III) and the alkali metal trifluoroethoxide are each dissolved in a solvent and the solution of the bromide is added dropwise into the alkoxide solution under temperature control; the mixture is quenched with water, the layers separated, the organic layer washed with saturated brine, the solvent distilled off, and the product recrystallised and dried to give the compound of formula (IV).
notes: Step (iv), displacement of the benzylic bromide by trifluoroethoxide. CF3CH2OM is defined at line 306 as CF3CH2ONa or CF3CH2OK, so the generic identifier and both specific salts are carried in compounds[] as one choice, not three charges. The only temperature printed is the addition temperature at line 312, worded 控制反应物温度不超过-5～15℃, literally that the reactant temperature during the dropwise addition is controlled so as not to exceed -5 to 15 degrees C; it is the step's only stated temperature so it is recorded in conditions as a range as well as in the addition_profile of the compound of formula (III). The wording 不超过 applied to a range is odd on its face and is recorded as printed rather than repaired. Anhydrous tetrahydrofuran is preferred, which implies dry conditions, but no atmosphere is stated so atmosphere is left null. Solvent, catalyst, initiator, brominating-agent and acid-binding-agent entries in compounds[] are the alternatives the text offers for this step, not a set of materials charged together. The text words them as lists with an optional preference; no charge, mass, volume or mole figure is printed anywhere in this section, so every quantity object is null.

procedure_text:
[0081] 本发明的式(IV)化合物可以通过但不限于如下插羰反应制备式(V)的羧酸化合物：
[0082] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述(v-1)的反应可以如下执行但不限于此：向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物、水、缚酸剂、催化剂、配体和第一溶剂，抽真空，氮气置换，通入CO，在80～120℃、优选80～90℃反应10～20h。过滤，蒸除第一溶剂后，加入第二溶剂溶解，调酸至pH为2～3，析出白色固体，过滤，得到式(V)化合物。
[0083] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中，催化剂使用钯、铑、钌、铜、钴等贵金属催化剂。
[0084] 在更具体的实施方式中，使用钯催化剂，具体例子包括但不限于氯化钯(PdCl₂)、碳酸钯(PdCO₃)、醋酸钯[Pd(OAc)₂]、钯/碳(Pd/C)、三氟乙酸钯[Pd(OTFA)₂]、双二亚苄基丙酮钯[Pd(dba)₂]等，优选氯化钯(PdCl₂)。
[0085] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中使用磷配体或其盐作为催化剂配体，优选1,3-(双二苯基膦)丙烷、1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷或者双[(4-N,N-二甲氨基)苯基]二叔丁基膦等。
[0086] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中使用的缚酸剂为三乙胺、碳酸钾、碳酸钠、碳酸铯(CsCO₃)、磷酸钾、N,N-二甲基乙酰胺(DMAC)、N,N-二异丙基乙胺(DIPEA)、1,8-二氮杂二环十一碳-7-烯(DBU)、三乙撑二胺(DABCO)等。
[0087] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应使用的第一溶剂是选自芳烃、亚砜、醚、酰胺类的溶剂，优选甲苯、1,4-二氧六环、乙二醇二甲醚、乙二醇二乙醚、二甲基亚砜(DMSO)、四氢呋喃(THF)、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺(DMF)中的一种或两种以上。
[0088] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中通入CO的压力约为1～4MPa。
[0089] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述反应中，蒸除第一溶剂后，加入醇溶剂例如甲醇或乙醇等作为第二溶剂溶解。
procedure_summary: The compound of formula (IV), water, an acid-binding agent, a noble metal catalyst, a phosphine ligand and a first solvent are charged into an autoclave, which is evacuated and purged with nitrogen before carbon monoxide is admitted and the mixture heated; the mixture is then filtered, the first solvent distilled off, the residue dissolved in an alcohol, and acidification precipitates the carboxylic acid of formula (V), which is filtered off.
notes: Reaction (v-1), palladium catalysed hydroxycarbonylation of the aryl bromide to the carboxylic acid of formula (V). reaction_class is other_cross_coupling at medium confidence: the closed reaction_class vocabulary has no carbonylation value, and this is a palladium catalysed C-C bond formation at an aryl bromide, so other_cross_coupling is the nearest member. The transformation tag carries the real name. The same value is used for the same formula (IV) to formula (V) carbonylation on Scheme Step 6 of this section, so the section classes that transformation one way throughout. Temperature is the stated 80-120 degrees C printed at line 320, which also gives a preferred sub-range of 80-90 degrees C. The preferred sub-range is carried as the tag temperature_preferred_c:80-90, because conditions.temperature holds one range and the schema forbids extra keys, so a tag is the only field on the record that can hold a second range where a consumer can find it. The 16 tag categories the pass lists have no category for it; this one is added rather than dropping a printed number. The same line prints a reaction time of 10 to 20 h. conditions.time_h is a single float and cannot hold a range, so it stays null rather than being collapsed to a point, and the range is carried as the tag time_h_range:10-20 as well as in the procedure text. This is the schema_loss_range case the project's own quantity-coverage contract names; validation_flags is a closed enum with no value for it, so the tag is the only machine-readable place for the number. The CO pressure is likewise a range, about 1-4 MPa at line 335, so value_kpa is null and the range is kept verbatim in pressure.qualitative_text. The workup pH is also a range, 2 to 3, so workup.ph_target is null and the phrase is in workup.steps. Five noble metals, six palladium sources with palladium chloride preferred, three phosphine ligands, nine acid-binding agents and seven first solvents are all alternatives. Solvent, catalyst, initiator, brominating-agent and acid-binding-agent entries in compounds[] are the alternatives the text offers for this step, not a set of materials charged together. The text words them as lists with an optional preference; no charge, mass, volume or mole figure is printed anywhere in this section, so every quantity object is null.

procedure_text:
[0090] 在其他实施方式中，本发明的式(IV)化合物可以通过但不限于如下插羰反应直接制备式(VIII)的酯化合物。
[0092] 在更具体的实施方式中，上述(v′－1)的反应的实施方法除了反应物中不加水之外，其它与前文所述(v-1)的反应的实施方法相同。
[0093] 由式(IV)化合物制备式(VIII)的中间体酯化合物后，可以先分离该中间体酯化合物，分步制备环磺酮，也可以不分离该中间体酯化合物而通过一锅法直接制备环磺酮。
[0094] 上述(v-1)和(v′－1)的反应中，列举了通过CO插羰的方式，但本发明不限于此，通过其它方式由式(IV)化合物制备式(V)所示的中间体酸化合物、或直接制备式(VIII)的中间体酯化合物的实施方式都包括在本发明范围内。
procedure_summary: In an alternative embodiment the compound of formula (IV) is carbonylated directly to the ester of formula (VIII); the procedure is stated to be the same as the carbonylation to the acid except that no water is charged.
notes: Reaction (v'-1), the direct carbonylative esterification that skips the acid of formula (V). conditions_inherited is true on the document's own instruction at line 352, that the method is the same as (v-1) except that no water is added to the reactants; the condition fields are therefore left null and point at Step 7 rather than being copied, which would create a second place for those ranges to drift. The cyclohexane-1,3-dione that must supply the ester oxygen is drawn on the arrow at lines 341 and 375 and is named in no sentence of this section, hence reagent_drawn_not_written; the prose at line 339 says only 插羰反应 (carbonyl insertion) to the compound of formula (VIII). Line 354 adds that the ester may either be isolated and carried on stepwise, or left unisolated and converted to tembotrione in one pot; that is an option offered for the pair Step 8 and Step 9, not a description of this step, so is_one_pot stays false here. Line 356 states that carbonyl insertion with CO is only an example and other means are within scope.

procedure_text:
[0091] 式(V)的羧酸化合物和式(VIII)的酯化合物是环磺酮的重要制备中间体，可以参照例如专利文献DE19846792A1等中公开的已知方法通过如下路线制备环磺酮。

procedure_summary: The ester of formula (VIII) is rearranged to tembotrione, preferably with a cyanide type catalyst and particularly with acetone cyanohydrin.
notes: The final acyl migration that converts the enol ester of formula (VIII) into the 2-aroyl-1,3-cyclohexanedione, tembotrione. reaction_class is other because the vocabulary has no rearrangement value and none of the listed classes describes an intramolecular acyl transfer; the transformation tag carries it. The drawn product IUQAXCIUEPFPSF-UHFFFAOYSA-N has the same molecular formula C17H16ClF3O6S as the drawn ester OBAMHTWSCBVWGB-UHFFFAOYSA-N, which is what an isomerisation should show, so no molar_mass_inconsistent is raised. Only the catalyst preference is stated, at line 348: no solvent, temperature, time or workup, hence no_conditions. Line 343 attributes the whole route from the acid of formula (V) and the ester of formula (VIII) through to tembotrione to known methods in DE19846792A1, which is not in this document, hence cross_reference_unresolved. Line 354 offers running this step one-pot with Step 8 without isolating the ester; that option is recorded here in prose but is_one_pot is false because the record as written starts from the isolated ester.
